title: Skill: emit final state as exactly the goal_state fields
objective: Fix the deterministic grader's failed `goal:bookings` check by teaching the refund-workflow skill that the emitted final state must match the task's `goal_state` exactly (only the annotated fields; drop unannotated fields such as date/status/seats/items) and that verification must compare against `goal_state`, not `initial_state`.
statement: The grader (src/workflow-grader.ts deepEqual over the union of keys) fails `goal:bookings` whenever the final bookings record retains any field the goal does not annotate; on task-005-booking-refusal the agent kept the initial_state shape (route/date/status/seats/changes) while the goal annotates only route/changes, and the e2e prompt even instructs 'keep the same shape as initial_state', so the refusal was correct but the check failed. Applying this skill change raises task_success_rate on the 5-task tau-style e2e set from 0.80 to at least 1.00 (delta >= +0.2, task-005 flips from fail to pass and task-002 stays passing) on the held-out booking cases without regressing the golden refund cases.

regressions.summary: The exact-shape rule could cause the agent to drop unannotated fields on a future task whose goal_state annotates only a subset of a record's fields; within the current 5-task set every goal annotation is complete and the passing tasks (001-004) already require the same minimal shape, so no current case regresses.
